reviewed.title: Reseal AMM optional-context manifests without untracked bytecode caches (fixes evidence and pump-amm CI on main)
reviewed.head: 9b849d6d81d9b0979afca2b143a4f713655b147f
reviewed.body:
## Problem

`main` at `b855ede0` fails two `Verify captured evidence` jobs, `evidence` and `pump-amm`
([run 40568431970](https://github.com/lalalune/pumpfun-source/actions/runs/40568431970)).
Both fail inside the selected PumpSwap checkpoint:

```
subprocess.CalledProcessError: Command '[... 'repro/pump_amm/optional-context-recovery-20261027/verify_saved.py', '--current-source']' returned non-zero exit status 1.
```

The cause is not visible in CI because `scripts/verify_pump_amm_checkpoint.py` captured the
inner verifier's stderr. Reproduced on a clean checkout of `b855ede0`:

```
$ python -B repro/pump_amm/optional-context-recovery-20261027/verify_saved.py --current-source
  File ".../verify_saved.py", line 20, in main
    assert set(entries)|{'manifest.json'}=={str(f.relative_to(d))for f in d.rglob('*')if f.is_file()}
AssertionError
```

`results/manifest.json` (digest `caf47424…`) lists 9,832 files; git holds 9,831 of them. The two
entries that no checkout can contain are

```
new-proofs/lineage/independent-next/reader/__pycache__/elf_reader.cpython-314.pyc
new-proofs/lineage/v2-source-abi/reader/__pycache__/elf_reader.cpython-314.pyc
```

`.gitignore` line 3 excludes `__pycache__/`, so these bytecode caches existed only in the
authoring checkout when the manifest was sealed. The same two files are also sealed into the
`independent-next` and `v2-source-abi` lineage manifests, and `verify_recovery.py` runs the
`independent-next` packet verifier, which performs the same whole-directory manifest comparison.

Bisection by CI history: the `evidence` job last passed at `0cc61d63` (17:45Z). The checkpoint
was selected by `5f295723` (19:10Z); every later main run has failed or been cancelled.

## Requirement served

`approvedScope`: verification tooling and evidence integrity. `requiredTests` name
`verify_evidence.py`, `test_tooling.py` and the `verify.yml` suites; the `evidence` and
`pump-amm` suites cannot pass on `main` until the selected checkpoint's manifest matches the
committed tree.

## Change

Commit 1, `Reseal AMM optional-context manifests without untracked bytecode caches`:

- drop the two `__pycache__` entries from the three manifests (top-level, `independent-next`,
  `v2-source-abi`);
- record the two lineage manifests' new digests in `results/manifest.json`;
- replace the top-level manifest digest in the four places that pin it: `verify_saved.py`,
  `scripts/verify_pump_amm_checkpoint.py`, the package README and `repro/status.json`
  (`checkpoint_manifest_sha256`).

  Old: `caf47424343c92b0bf15354c14129b89542062ef5c21316b3f77feaa1af33c38`
  New: `a00fa646e610ece0a0ea7f9d202bc7e6526d5a2e310d3881703f7d3c4a7d5cde`

Commit 2, `Keep the saved AMM verifier's stderr visible from the checkpoint wrapper`: capture
only stdout (it is parsed for the JSON report) so the inner failing assertion reaches the CI
log. With this change and the original manifests, the wrapper's stderr shows
`verify_saved.py, line 20 ... AssertionError` instead of a bare `CalledProcessError`.

No candidate, source, receipt, runtime record or verifier logic changes. The two receipts that
recorded the earlier lineage manifest digests as data
(`new-proofs/lineage/new-components.json`, `next-joint/independent-gains-verification.json`)
are left as written: they describe the runs that produced them. No `__pycache__` files are
committed.

Why this rather than the alternatives: the recorded `.pyc` bytes cannot be reproduced
(interpreter-version- and mtime-dependent), and relaxing the manifest comparison would weaken
the gate for every file. Removing the two entries is the smallest change that makes the sealed
inventory describe the committed tree.

## Evidence

Tested revision: `b855ede0` + these two commits. Python 3.12.3, `requirements.txt` pinned
packages (`solders==0.27.1`), Linux x86_64. The `--current-source` path binds the maintained
`programs/pump-amm` tree; it already equalled the canonical source before this change
(`verify_source_binding` passes with `current_source_verified: true`).

Before (unmodified `b855ede0`):

| Command | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `verify_saved.py --current-source` | `AssertionError` at line 20 after 1.3 s |
| `scripts/verify_pump_amm_checkpoint.py` | `CalledProcessError`, no cause shown |
| `scripts/verify_recovered_builds.py --program pump_amm` | fails through the wrapper |

After:

| Command | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `verify_saved.py --current-source` | exit 0, `current_source_checked: true`, 17,462 cases, 35,074 transactions, 35,418 signature fields, 651/148 windows (1 m 37 s) |
| `scripts/verify_pump_amm_checkpoint.py` | `status: PASS` (1 m 56 s) |
| `scripts/verify_recovered_builds.py --program pump_amm` | pass |
| `evidence` suite from `verify.yml` | all 38 commands exit 0, including `verify_recovered_builds.py` and `verify_current_reconstruction.py --repo .` (`PASS_CURRENT_RECONSTRUCTION`), `local_validation.py` with an unchanged `audit/local-validation.json` |
| `pump-amm` suite from `verify.yml` (`replay_parallel.py` + `--runtime`) | pass: `replay_parallel.py` exit 0, then `--runtime` report `status: PASS`, 17,462 cases, 35,074 transactions, 35,418 signature fields, 17,537 identical signed-message pairs, `mismatches: []` |

## Limits

- This restores the gate; it does not add coverage or change any reconstruction count.
- The `pump-amm` suite's 17,462-case replay was executed locally with the workflow's exact commands (8 workers).
- The hosted `main` run is still queued for its remaining jobs; the `pump-amm` job on `main`
  completed with the same failure at 01:31Z.

reviewed.body:
The route's FeeConfig alias made the generated external account share one Borsh reader across route, buy_exact_quote and external decoding. Give the route its own ordinary Rust type with the same six ordered fields and derives. This restores the original complete 1,176-byte / 142-instruction unchecked decoder at 0x1159d8, replacing the previous 408-byte delegating body, and closes the checked wrapper's unequal final call at 0x1156f0 + 728.

On the same ordinary Linux v1.44 SBF build, the locally rebuilt sourcefronts780 parent rises from **780 to 781 / 1,035 injective normalized windows**. Exactly one signature is gained, zero are lost, and all 121 raw matches are retained. Two actual root recompilations produce identical complete stripped and symbols ELFs, with all 60 source inputs and 355 dependency artifacts unchanged between repeats. The earlier Cargo Fresh cache hit is explicitly disqualified and preserved.

The decoder's five direct calls match. Following actual direct/imported calls gives 32 matching window pairs and 53 equal edges; its two relocated root records also agree. Separately, 567 unambiguous previously matched roots retain every one of their 6,082 equal direct-call bindings and gain this one binding (6,083 / 6,125). No previously equal destination regresses. Duplicate groups, seven indirect sites, transitive data/control-flow and whole-original ELF identity remain outside the proof.

The exact candidate passed its own local captured-loader **44-suite / 10,468-case** matrix, with **10,464 paired diagnostic-log cases and zero mismatches**. All original/candidate actual loaded hashes, source bindings, suite reports and loader receipts are retained. This includes the 372 configured-fee and 352 exact-quote cases. Diagnostic comparisons exclude source coordinates and compute usage; each suite's state/CPI/signature oracle retains its stated limits. No previous runtime result is retagged.

The source delta is `research/pump-feeconfig-decoder-recovery/local-feeconfig.patch`; the full proposed Rust file and both authenticated 60-file snapshots are included. `verify.py` recomputes the census, real call destinations, typed records, repeat identity and saved runtime bindings, and has a dedicated CI entry. Maintained source/checkpoint selection is unchanged by this research proposal.

Parent credit: #342 at 3887bcf3fbcfe308c986094a51a99bf75240a0a7 and its attributed source stages. The final public-head review also checked #352–#359 and #342's separate SBPF v2-rent profile at 36387c009159c22b0c109e7f9c1398f3bc6dde17; none implements this FeeConfig split, and #342 still explicitly lists this decoder gap. Their counts and runtime results are not transferred here. This PR claims one new SBF source recovery, not their earlier recoveries or a comparison of unlike SBF/SBPF counts. Historical source spelling and complete ELF equality are not established.

reviewed.title: Verify AMM Token-2022 fee activation with persistent signed swaps
reviewed.head: 52af415577e3a516134aa5a69b3287ca18d0984e
reviewed.body:
The existing AMM corpus mostly recreates accounts for each test; its standard transfer-fee fixture duplicates the old/new fee records. Separate TLV probes already exercise isolated old/new selection. This independent replay adds the missing persistent-state guarantee: withheld fees and balances survive schedule activation, a rejected swap, and a successful retry in the same VM.

Four fee profiles (increase, decrease, capped 100% activation and disable) run across the captured AMM, maintained 651 checkpoint and unchanged #319 g02-c726 artifact. The 12 sequences contain 48 normally signed transactions: 36 successes and 12 slippage rejections. All 32 candidate/original pairs agree in state, error, inner instructions, return data and serialized events. An independent integer oracle accounts for 144 actual Token-2022 TransferChecked CPIs, including sender debits, spendable recipient credits, withheld increments and the BuyEvent fee suffix.

Validation: actual loader and fixture-input hashes; all 48 cryptographic signatures; continuous account state between sends; rollback except the normal payer fee; fresh portable local execution; six receipt-corruption controls plus a fixed-value rounding/cap check. Packet verifier, new-runtime CLI, YAML and staged whitespace checks pass. The existing pump-amm CI job runs the verifier and falsifiers.

See [scope, exact commands and limits](research/amm-transfer-fee-epoch/README.md). This credits the existing reconstruction and adds no contract-source change, native build, function-match count or frontier promotion. All raw logs remain retained; known diagnostic-origin differences are not claimed equal. Transfer-fee ABI recovery remains with its existing source lane, and #328's two diagnostic-origin regressions remain unresolved. No original binary, captured account or public candidate is modified; no live-chain transaction is used.

The existing broad matrix excludes full logs, so these diagnostic differences are not reported by its normal comparison.

This independent packet credits #315 and #319 and supplies an offline reproduction across original/651/693/726. Three math-boundary cases establish the corrected `constant_product.rs:85` origin against the old `:17` control. It also resolves all 11 actual pointer sites in the complete math helper, including error discriminants, vtables, panic Location and Source records, and follows 39 matching function pairs / 138 actual direct edges per candidate.

Validation: 15 cases across four unchanged artifacts, repeated through fresh-VM portable execution: 120 normal signed transactions, zero paired error-code/state/inner/return differences, every raw diagnostic retained. Six in-memory corruption controls pass. Packet verification checks actual loader hashes, all transaction signatures, failed-account rollback, source inputs and stripped/symbol allocated sections. YAML and staged whitespace checks pass; the existing pump-amm CI job runs the packet verifier and falsifiers.

See [the report and commands](research/amm-math-error-reference/README.md). This is independent verification, not a competing handler implementation. It does not claim the two composition diagnostics are fixed, a fresh native build, new function counts, transitive data/indirect-call closure, production exploitability or whole-ELF equality. Apart from normalized-unique bodies, the section identities are ordering hypotheses. No original bytes enter the compiler or linker, and no generated output is patched.

- The default build through the same driver (`tools/build_linux.py`, `cargo rustc -- -Clinker=<capture wrapper>`) reproduces the base byte-for-byte (`0881a95d…` / `16ddd88d…`).

- Runtime: the maintained 25-suite replay ran on `b05f7268…`. It covered 17,462 cases, 35,074 transactions and 35,418 signatures, with **0 mismatches**. Per-case digests are in the packet.
- `verify.py` passes. It recomputes the counts with the repository measurement and applies a strict selector grammar against the default map. It also regenerates the script from `tools/`, checks a byte-level translation proof for the stripped and symbol ELFs, and checks the receipts, both builds, the runtime digests and the inventory. `test_scope.py` passes 9/9 mutation controls.
- Multiplicity deficit, disclosed: `0xf4030` and `0xf4180` are normalized windows with no free equal body, so 645 of the 647 normalized windows can be placed.   472/472 functions equal to their linked bytes; 395/396 matched windows reproduce the original, the 1 is a same-named sysroot body).
- Hazard documented: `cargo --build-plan` deletes `.rlib` files in the target dir it is pointed at.

`linux_build.py` reproduced `0881a95d…`/`16ddd88d…`; no runtime differential needed (no program bytes change).

**What it is:** a re-runnable source-coordinate placement solver (`tools/solve.py`: input tree + its unstripped build → placed tree + `source.patch` + report) and its application:

- one structural copy: original `base_for_quote` (0x12310) calls its own `#[inline(never)]` copy of the constant-product quotient (0x123a0), restored as `base_for_buy`;
- legacy sell module path: `legacy_sell.rs` merged into `instructions/swap/sell.rs` (the original path of the handler, its closures and `validate_pool_v2`); lib.rs `use instructions::swap::sell as legacy_sell;` keeps all paths;
- identical `|_| error!()` closures paired through the call graph of their callers;
- `core::panic::Location` lines placed where order allows (program-crate Location records exact 20 → 31 of 38; raw/whole-ELF only).
